answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 6750 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: I would like to name my new born son MOHD MUSAB or MOHD AMR. What is the meaning and which one you suggest. Question: ASSLAMOALAIKIM I would like to name my new born son MOHD MUSAB or MOHD AMR. What is the meaning and which one you suggest. JAZAKALLAH Answer ID: 6750 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 703/703=M/1429) Mus?ab ( مصعب ) means: head, chief. You can name your son as: Muhammad Mus?ab ( محمد مصعب ), this is good name. There was a sahabi named Mus?ab bin Umair. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
